lines.zh: 我踩着草走，罐子在腰上响。
lines.en: I walk the grass and the gourds knock at my waist.

lines.zh: 我沿着村子的边界走一圈。
lines.en: I make a round along the village boundary.
Feathers sway on my head.
I reach the house and look at the door.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很轻，像在测量。
lines.en: My steps are light, as if measuring.
I cut through the vegetable plots.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边摇手里的东西。
lines.en: I shake what I carry as I walk.
The trees toward the jungle are too thick.

lines.zh: 我换了条路，往屋子后面去。
lines.en: I take another way round the back of the house.
I stop at the edge of the yard.
I straighten my grass skirt.
I move slowly toward the door.
My shadow is shorter than I am.
The wind chimes answer my steps.
I come round from the back to the front yard.

lines.zh: 我抬脚跨过门槛，慢慢走。
lines.en: I step over the sill and walk slowly.

lines.zh: 我坐在台阶上，捣着东西。
lines.en: I sit on the step, grinding something.

lines.zh: 我的屋里有蜂蜜的味道。
lines.en: My house smells of honey.
I hang herbs from the beam.
The cicadas have called all day.
I am counting what is left in the jars.
I turn my mask to the side.

lines.zh: 屋子是我自己搭的，四面有窗。
lines.en: I built this house myself, windows on every side.
There is a splash potion on the table.
I tap the rim of a bowl.

lines.zh: 外面有脚步，我不急着起来。
lines.en: Footsteps outside. I do not get up.

lines.zh: 我把一束羽毛插回头发里。
lines.en: I push a feather back into my hair.
This house faces south and holds the sun.

lines.zh: 你带着东西来，还是要东西。
lines.en: Do you come with goods, or for them?
I take emeralds here.

lines.zh: 我这儿收绿宝石，别的不收。
lines.en: I take emeralds here, nothing else.
Stay at the door. Do not come in.
If you want honey, I have honey.

lines.zh: 你看我这屋子，还缺一根梁。
lines.en: You see this house. It wants a beam still.
I do no fortune telling. Do not ask.
Your shadow crossed the threshold before you.
Say plainly what you want to buy.

lines.zh: 丛林里的东西，我都认得。
lines.en: I know everything in that jungle.
One of my jars has broken.
I retreat inside to guard the table.
That landed on my shoulder and numbed it.
My headdress slipped; I set it right.
It hurts. I am still standing.
I press my mask back on.
Blood dripped on the sill.
Behind this mask, I have marked you.
That goes on the account.
I back slowly into the house.
That honey I would take.
I sniff. That is good stuff.
Emeralds only. Nothing else.

lines.zh: 你拿这个来，是走错了门。
lines.en: You brought that to the wrong door.
Set it down and let me judge the worth.

lines.zh: 这点分量，不够一瓶药水。
lines.en: That is not worth one potion.
I will take it. Only one portion.
That smell takes me back to the swamp.

lines.zh: 我腰上的罐子一碰就响。
lines.en: The gourds at my waist rattle with every step.
I am not greedy, nor do I lose out.
Do not stand that close to the door.
I step back. Now you may stand.

lines.zh: 你鞋跟踩进我的草药堆
lines.en: Your heel is in my herb pile.
There is much inside. Do not knock it.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我把罐子扶住了。
lines.en: At that bump I steadied my jars.
I dislike being crowded.
Make way. I am going to the hearth.
You are taller than me. Do not block the light.
The sill is old. Do not break it.
Let us each stand on our own side.
I have lived alone a long while.
There are a few wizards over in the jungle.
We do not visit often.

lines.zh: 有个老巫医送过我一罐东西。
lines.en: An old witch doctor once gave me a jar.
I have kept it and never used it.

lines.zh: 我屋子里的东西，都是自己攒的。
lines.en: Everything here I gathered myself.
Someone came once and left again.
I do not keep guests.
There is one bed in this house.

lines.zh: 夜里我听着林子，睡得很浅。
lines.en: At night I listen to the wood and sleep light.
An emerald on the ground.
I pick it up and hold it to the light.
This stone is of no use.
I carry the honey jar inside.
I will keep this herb.
That emerald by the door is mine.
This is too light. Worthless.

lines.zh: 有人把东西落在门口了。
lines.en: Someone left this at the door.
One fold of my sleeve and it is hidden.
If this is for me, I take it.
Someone has stopped outside the door.

lines.zh: 我听见有人把罐子放下。
lines.en: I hear a jar set down.
He puts a hand through the doorway.
I get up and walk over.
He looks like he wants to trade.

lines.zh: 我先把桌上的东西收好。
lines.en: First I clear the table.
He is still waiting at the door.
I open the door and look at him.
He has something in his hand.
This one I can talk to.
He stands in the middle of the yard.
I look him over once.
He keeps reaching into his pocket.
His eyes keep going to the honey.

lines.zh: 我把他要看的都摆出来。
lines.en: I set out everything worth looking at.
He reaches for the potion.
I put a hand in the way.
He draws his hand back.
He looks at the honey again.

lines.zh: 我在等他把绿宝石拿出来。
lines.en: I wait for the emerald.
He finally brings it out.
I look at the cut and color.
He is eyeing the herbs on the frame.
I do not intend to let him touch them.
I raise a hand and push the bottle across.

lines.zh: 他伸手抓，我按住他的手。
lines.en: He grabs for it and I pin his hand.

lines.zh: 我这摊子，收绿宝石换药水。
lines.en: My stall takes emeralds for potions.

lines.zh: 我把喷溅药水摔在地上。
lines.en: I break a splash potion on the floor.
Smoke fills the room at once.

lines.zh: 他退到门槛上，咳个不停。
lines.en: He falls back to the sill, coughing.
I break another.
He cannot stand this smell.
I push him out.
The door shuts in his face.

lines.zh: 我从屋里走出来，站到院子里。
lines.en: I come out of the house into the yard.

lines.zh: 这间屋子已经可以住人了。
lines.en: This house is fit to live in.

lines.zh: 是我的屋子，我自己认下的。
lines.en: It is mine, and I claimed it.

lines.zh: 我把草药挂到外面的架子上。
lines.en: I hang herbs on the outside frame.
I swept the yard already.
By the jungle the wind is always damp.

lines.zh: 我朝屋里看了一眼，还行。
lines.en: I glance inside. It will do.
Two empty jars stand by the door.
Mask on; the shop opens today.
Someone will likely come today.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的草裙，我拍打。
lines.en: Fire caught my grass skirt and I beat at it.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下，摔得背疼。
lines.en: I fell off the step and my back took it.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水灌进嘴里，药瓶也翻了。
lines.en: Swamp water fills my mouth; a potion bottle tipped.

lines.zh: 爆响把屋里的罐子都震倒。
lines.en: The blast knocked every jar in the room over.

lines.zh: 一支箭插进了门框，也擦到我。
lines.en: An arrow stuck in the frame and grazed me.

lines.zh: 怪光缠上我的手腕，解不开。
lines.en: Strange light wound round my wrist.
There is little left to eat in the house.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的羽毛全竖了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and my feathers stood up.
The floor was gone and I fell into the dark.
